evidence.velocity_vs_rigour: Promote strong data quality, consistent system usage and audit-ready, well-documented outputs.
evidence.velocity_vs_rigour_explanation: The JD repeatedly emphasizes data governance, GDPR compliance, audit-readiness, and documented data dictionaries, with no velocity/speed language present, placing this at rigour.
evidence.domain_risk: Support regulatory and compliance reporting using structured, auditable data inputs.
evidence.domain_risk_explanation: Property/real estate reporting with explicit GDPR compliance, regulated operational environment references, and auditable regulatory reporting responsibilities places this at high — the JD names 'regulated operational environment' and 'regulatory or compliance data' directly.
evidence.collaboration_width: COO; CFO; Property Management; Block Management; Leasing; Asset Management; Resident Services
evidence.data_team_maturity_explanation: A named 'Operations Centre of Excellence' and existing Yardi/Power BI reporting infrastructure are already in place and being extended/improved, indicating a growing but already-functioning reporting function rather than a from-zero build.
evidence.jd_authorship: Develop custom DAX measures for advanced logic such as void analysis, case ageing, yield and occupancy metrics.
evidence.jd_authorship_explanation: Responsibilities name precise domain-specific technical scope (Yardi, Power Query/DAX, void analysis, case ageing, yield/occupancy metrics, property/unit/tenancy hierarchy) that shows exactly what the role does day to day.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation: Sitting within the Operations Centre of Excellence and partnering closely with the COO and CFO
evidence.stakeholder_orientation_explanation: The role reports closely to the CFO and handles yield, capital values, valuations, and regulatory/compliance reporting, an executive-financial reporting orientation.
evidence.autonomy_level: This is an opportunity to be at the forefront of shaping and informing decision making within the real estate market... The successful candidate will shape the way real estate reporting is delivered, setting a new standard for the industry.
evidence.autonomy_level_explanation: The role combines strategic framing (shape reporting standards, define KPIs with business owners) with detailed hands-on execution (writing DAX measures, building dashboards to spec), making this mixed.
evidence.ai_role_explanation: No AI tooling or AI-adjacent responsibility is mentioned anywhere in the JD.
evidence.testing_framing: Implement and maintain appropriate data access controls, including Row Level Security where required. Promote strong data quality, consistent system usage and audit-ready, well-documented outputs.
evidence.testing_framing_explanation: Data quality, governance, and audit-readiness are framed as an owned responsibility with explicit action verbs (implement, maintain, promote), not just tools in a skills list.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing: Produce master, redacted and aggregated versions of dashboards to comply with GDPR and support relevant stakeholder needs. Support regulatory and compliance reporting using structured, auditable data inputs.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing_explanation: GDPR compliance, regulatory reporting, and audit-ready outputs are named repeatedly and prominently within a dedicated 'Data Governance, Security and Compliance' section, placing this at high.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix: Replace legacy custom reports and standalone spreadsheets with BI-based, single-source-of-truth equivalents.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix_explanation: The role both replaces/improves existing fragmented reporting (fix/scale) and builds new semantic models, KPIs, and data structures from Yardi/business inputs (greenfield), making this mixed.
evidence.loss_aversion: Produce master, redacted and aggregated versions of dashboards to comply with GDPR — reflects a dominant regulatory/compliance risk register throughout the Governance section, placing this at high.
